$comment: Lighthouse CI config for atlas (Phase 9). Audits the BUILT + SERVED
production surface on :3093 (next start, NOT next dev — the strict CSP
forbids unsafe-eval and next dev cannot run under it; the AGENT_NOTES CSP
lesson carried from meld/razors-edge/pulse).
The SEO-bearing PUBLIC surface is /about: a Server Component rendered
entirely from static deterministic content (the pitch + a static fleet
snapshot table + the route/zone reference + JSON-LD/OG), with NO client-only
data dependency — it SSRs identically every request, scores Lighthouse from
static HTML, and is meaningful with JS disabled. That is the >= 95 SEO
front door.
The live operations MAP at / is DELIBERATELY EXEMPT (documented, ADR-001 /
AGENT_NOTES 'Performance budget'): it is an app surface with a client-only
live-data first paint (the WebSocket + the WebGL map), not an SEO surface,
and has no crawler value. Its budget is the 60 fps interpolation frame
budget, not Lighthouse-SEO. So Lighthouse targets /about only.
Asserts the CLAUDE.md s4 / PLAN.md success criteria: >= 95 in all four
categories on /about, median of 5 runs, plus Core Web Vitals (LCP < 2.5s,
CLS < 0.1). Desktop preset matches the recruiter audience.
NOTE: LHCI does NOT need atlas-server or Postgres up — /about renders from
the STATIC deterministic snapshot (no live fetch), so it is self-contained.
Bring up `pnpm -F atlas-web build && pnpm -F atlas-web start` first, then
point LHCI at the already-served :3093.
